2026_04_GB_TB.headline: Green Bay can crowd the box against Tampa Bay’s rookie-quarterback reset
2026_04_GB_TB.paragraph1: Tampa Bay enters Week 4 winless and without Baker Mayfield, who is expected to miss at least three weeks after dislocating his right thumb. Rookie Jalon Daniels is set to start, putting extra pressure on the Buccaneers to protect him and create manageable early downs. Green Bay can respond by tightening coverage and challenging Daniels to sustain drives, although Tampa Bay corner Zyon McCollum’s strong start gives the Bucs a defensive piece capable of making the Packers earn their passing-game production.
2026_04_GB_TB.model_rationale: Tampa Bay’s quarterback transition shifts the burden toward protection and manageable downs, while Green Bay can force the rookie to prove he can consistently beat disciplined coverage.
